headline: The Last of Us: Joel and Ellie
title: The Last of Us Facts | Naughty Dog Classic | Classic Games
video_script: The Last of Us came out in June twenty thirteen on PlayStation three, from Naughty Dog. Joel, a smuggler who lost his daughter, escorts Ellie, a girl immune to the Cordyceps fungus infection that wrecked America. Neil Druckmann and Bruce Straley led the game, and it became one of the most praised games ever. By January twenty twenty three, the franchise had sold over thirty seven million games. Joel or Ellie? Comment below!
description: The Last of Us (Naughty Dog, June 2013, PS3): Joel and Ellie in a Cordyceps-ravaged America; franchise sold over 37 million by January 2023. Source: Wikipedia.
